description: This file defines the SheetViews class responsible for parsing and applying view settings from an XLSX sheet view XML to a Worksheet object in PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: SheetViews
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing sheet view XML and applying view settings to a Worksheet object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SheetViews object with XML data and a Worksheet.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and applies various sheet view settings such as zoom, view type, gridlines, headers, direction, zeros display, pane, and selection.

methods.name: zoomScale
methods.description: Sets the zoom scale and normal zoom scale for the worksheet view.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Sets the view type of the worksheet (e.g., page layout, normal).

methods.name: topLeft
methods.description: Sets the top-left cell of the view.

methods.name: gridLines
methods.description: Configures the display of grid lines.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Configures the display of row and column headers.

methods.name: pane
methods.description: Configures frozen panes based on XML attributes.

methods.name: selection
methods.description: Sets the selected cells based on XML attributes.
